snippet.title: ReBlade: The Death Spiral - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the ReBlade: The Death Spiral announcement trailer for the upcoming cyberpunk action roguelike game developed by ChillyRoom. ReBlade: The Death Spiral will be available on PC.

In ReBlade: The Death Spiral, play as a condemned Synthetic trapped in a cyberpunk world distorted by false immortality and endless resets. You must fight through a city overrun by mechanical creatures, and refine your build by combining weapons, chips, and augments as each cycle uncovers new strategies and combat possibilities. Through repeated resets, you learn, adapt, and push deeper into the city, gradually uncovering the truth behind this mysterious world and carving your path to freedom.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489340/ReBlade_The_Death_Spiral
